scope.campaign: Search | NonBrand | AC Repair | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-08
scope.why_this_campaign_only: All seven observed vehicle and marine AC search terms occurred in the AC Repair campaign. Applying the negatives to the other four campaigns would be speculative, because no automotive term has been observed there. If one appears later the monitoring plan catches it and the scope can be widened on evidence.
scope.why_not_account_level: The ACCOUNT_LEVEL_NEGATIVE_KEYWORDS set 11252984411 applies to all 23 campaigns in the account, including legacy campaigns outside this engagement. Campaign-level keeps the blast radius to the campaign that actually produced the waste.
scope.why_not_a_shared_list: No shared set is attached to any of the five campaigns today, and attaching one would change that property. Campaign-level negatives preserve it.

conflict_testing_2026_08_22.carrier_brand_safety: Negative keywords match on whole words. Negative broad 'car' does NOT block 'carrier ac repair', because 'carrier' is a different word. Explicitly tested.

terms_deliberately_NOT_negated.goodman certified technician near me: NOT negated. Goodman is an HVAC brand. A homeowner searching for a Goodman-certified technician may want service Ambient can perform. An earlier automated pass flagged it on the token 'certified'; that was too aggressive and is withdrawn.
terms_deliberately_NOT_negated.home depot mini split installation cost: NOT negated. $17.24, one click. Retailer-framed, but the searcher wants mini-split installation, which Ambient performs. Classified WATCH, not NEGATIVE. One click is not a repeated pattern.
terms_deliberately_NOT_negated.lowes hvac installation: NOT negated. Zero clicks, zero cost. WATCH.
terms_deliberately_NOT_negated.midea hvac distributor near me: NOT negated. Zero clicks. Distributor intent is weak but unproven at one occurrence.
terms_deliberately_NOT_negated.single_word_service_terms: repair, installation, replacement, boiler, furnace, ac, hvac, heating, commercial and residential were NOT considered. They are on the agency caution list and would block core demand.
terms_deliberately_NOT_negated.protected_terms: near me, quote, price, pricing, cost, best, hire, local and emergency were NOT considered. Agency policy protects them.

expected_impact: Prevents recurrence of vehicle and marine AC clicks in the AC Repair campaign. Based on the observed 8-day window this is roughly $47.78 of avoided waste, about 4.8% of AC Repair spend. It does not add reach and will not raise conversions by itself.
risk: LOW. Three campaign-level negatives, fully reversible, zero conflict, zero converting terms blocked.
